featured_reviews.review_text:
We had done a baby shower event on 30th Oct where we hired Sushant for the photography work.

Sushant seemed very polite and even during the event we were happy with his approach. On the day of the event, everything was perfect. Sushant was on time and took a lot of photos.

We started noticing glitches in the sample. The link that he shared was not optimised for the mobile phones.

Then the blunder started , all the photos he clicked didn't have proper settings.Even in natural setting the photos were too dark.

Some of the photos were corrupt, as he couldn't open in his camera. We came to know about it when we asked for the photos.

He ruined all our photos, and was blaming us for the camera settings. The worst part was the customer service, we called him multiple times to edit the photos and share it with us. He was always busy and didnt bother even to call back once.

After sales service is pathetic. The worst part is our precious moments are spoilt. They cannot correct these mistakes. The impact is more than a mere transaction.

The least they could have done is own up their mistake and give us a call back.

I would not recommend them for any photography work as they don't care about people emotions.
